name: Casper Kelly
bio: Chris "Casper" Kelly is an American filmmaker. He is best known for directing the horror comedy film Buddy (2026).

credits.title: Buddy
credits.overview: Inside the colorful world of "It's Buddy!", a group of children spend their days singing, dancing, and helping Buddy - bright orange unicorn - spread happiness. But when one child refuses to play along, Buddy is not pleased and cracks begin to appear in this seemingly perfect world.

credits.title: V/H/S/Halloween
credits.overview: A collection of Halloween-themed videotapes unleashes a series of twisted, blood-soaked tales, turning trick-or-treat into a struggle for survival.

credits.title: Adult Swim Yule Log 2: Branchin' Out
credits.overview: Zoe tries to escape the horrors of the first film by fleeing to a new country, but the murder log has travel plans of its own.
roles: Coral Co-Worker / Morenament Voice / Sheriff's Deputy

credits.title: Adult Swim Yule Log
credits.overview: Get in the holiday spirit with this cozy, crackling fire.

credits.title: Danny Ketchup
credits.overview: Action. In this latest installment of the blockbuster movie franchise, super agent Danny Ketchup must save the world from terrorists who have developed a Supergun with bullets the size of Washington, D.C. With Danielle Pepperjack, and Paran Thakur as Milton Horseradish.

credits.title: Mandy
credits.overview: The Shadow Mountains, 1983. Red and Mandy lead a loving and peaceful existence; but when their pine-scented haven is savagely destroyed, Red is catapulted into a phantasmagoric journey filled with bloody vengeance and laced with fire.

credits.title: Final Deployment 4: Queen Battle Walkthrough
credits.overview: Tips and tricks on how to beat the alien queen boss battle in Final Deployment 4 (Multi-platform) as well as the "Homecoming" DLC.

credits.title: Too Many Cooks
credits.overview: "Too Many Cooks" is a humorous parody of US sitcoms of the 1970s and the 1980s, meanwhile what seems like an interminable opening theme, a mysterious killer makes his way and kills (preparing a lunch with their limbs) various members of the Cook Family.

credits.title: Please Please Pick Up
credits.overview: A poignant yet comic story of loneliness and handjobs.

credits.title: Night of the Living Doo
credits.overview: In a spoof of 1972's The New Scooby-Doo Movies, Scooby-Doo and the Mystery Inc. gang pick up a hitchiking Gary Coleman. Soon after, the Mystery Machine proceeds to break down (multiple times) leaving them stranded at a haunted castle owned by David Cross.

credits.title: Major Flake: Soggy Sale
credits.overview: Major Flake, a frenetic French cereal mascot, and his grim sidekick, Sparkles, must find a way to sell their rather unappealing Major Flake cereal before their boss, Sylvia Soggy, pulls the breakfast treat from store shelves.

credits.title: The Scooby-Doo Project
credits.overview: In the Fall of 1999, four teenage sleuths and their Great Dane got lost in the woods while in search of a mystery. This is their story.

credits.title: Thanks a Latte
credits.overview: Droopy pursues a rude customer for a tip
